title: Calm active launch readiness gates
summary: Adjusted the Launch compact gate so active-work-only backend preflight blocks render as the existing Active/running state instead of Will Fail/blocked. Real backend blockers still render as Will Fail.
reason: During a normal active pipeline run, backend launch guards correctly reject duplicate starts. The compact gate was presenting that expected protection as bright red failure, creating false-positive operator alarm.
behavior_before: When a run was already active, active_work/process_launch_lock preflight checks made the compact Launch gate show Will Fail with blocked styling across Backend, Queue, Schedule, and Active tiles.
behavior_after: When active_work/process_launch_lock are the only compact-gate blockers, the compact Launch gate shows Active/running styling. Non-active backend blockers such as config identity still show Will Fail/blocked styling.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_launch_command_buttons_smoke -q (fails before completion on existing launch-readiness-actions page markup assertion in the dirty worktree)
rollback_plan: Revert the compact-gate active-work classification changes in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/launchView.scope.js and remove the added compact-gate smoke assertion.
notes:
Demote active-work-only compact launch gate blockers to the existing running/active presentation state.
Add Node-backed compact gate smoke covering active-work-only versus real backend blockers.
Refresh generated summary for the touched Launch compact gate module.
Refresh generated summary for the touched Launch WebView smoke test.
